messages:
Alex Ramos: Hey team — first day kit arrived. Quick setup issues: dock (USB4) powers laptop but monitor shows 'No Signal'. Dock has HDMI + DP; I currently have HDMI plugged. Also my USB-A keyboard on the dock keeps disconnecting every ~30s. Finally, during VPN/SSO the corp-wifi cert prompt never appeared and VPN fails with 'certificate not found'. Should I open a ticket or try anything first?

Chris (IT): Welcome! A few quick checks: 1) Is the monitor input set to HDMI? 2) Try swapping to the DP cable on the dock if available. 3) For the keyboard, try the rear USB-A port. 4) For the cert, did you see a system prompt during first-run of the corp VPN? Also what's your laptop model?

Alex Ramos: Laptop is ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 (Windows 11). Monitor is Dell U2723Q. Input was HDMI — I swapped to DP on both ends, still black. Rear USB-A still disconnects. I ran ipconfig /all and here's the relevant bit: ```Ethernet adapter vEthernet (WSL):\n   Connection-specific DNS Suffix . :\n   IPv4 Address. . . . . . . . . : 172.18.5.22\n   Default Gateway . . . . . . . . : 172.18.0.1\n``` Not sure if that helps for the cert, but VPN error is "certificate not found" when authenticating.

Chris (IT): Thanks. Two next steps: a) open Device Manager (devmgmt.msc) and check for any warning triangles under USB controllers or Display adapters; b) try reseating the DP cable and try the other DP output on the dock if it has one. I also want you to try a quick firmware check for the dock — use our internal updater: https://dock-fw.redwood.example/update and follow the Windows steps. If you can't run it, tell me and I'll push. I'll open a ticket so we can track replacements if necessary.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2047 created by Chris (IT) for Alex Ramos — "Dock DP passthrough + keyboard disconnect + WiFi cert not provisioning". Priority: P2. ETA: initial triage in 2 hours.

Priya Shah: Hey @Alex — welcome to Platform team :wave: I had the same dock last month. For me the fix was reseating the DP cable and switching to the other DP port on the dock. If that fails, IT shipped me a DP->USB-C adapter and a replacement dock next-day. I can swing by with the spare if you're in the SF office.

Alex Ramos: Reseated the DP cable again and swapped ports — monitor flickered once for a second then back to black. Keyboard still drops. Ticket noted. I can do a remote session if that helps; I'm free for the next 30 mins.

Chris (IT): Perfect — I'll start a remote support session in ~5 minutes and send an invite. If we can't get it stable, I'll mark IT-2047 for a replacement dock to ship tomorrow morning. :shipit:
